dv_age_deltas.derivation: per SU command: SU8 programme word +4 (QW-SUVM8: VM prog read +2, SU pins +2; accept chain c_su+2 -> c_su+6) + vm8l answer ring on p_q +6 (QW-SLICE2R lp record output_port_offset_edges p_q 6) + operand read vm8b 2 -> 4 (+2, QW-VM8SPLIT) + vm8l answer ring a_q/b_q/c_q/cr_q/bs_q +6 = +18 from command arrival to the first result; VM-written results (red_vm) +3 more (vm8l VM writes +3). vm8b write->read 1 -> 3 (+2) and the ring write +3 are covered by the next command's +10 accept chain (slack >= 5 edges, no extra). Applied to every measured SU-command age (ssq_psum_out, add_psum_out, xs_out, silu_out, red_vm, d2d.*); structural ages (root_cfg_lead, sc_hop_measured) unchanged. QW-TOKSCHED2 10-21: the SU part is now the SU8 leaf price (QW-SU8 qfd_dv_s5_su8_rst3 r4, claude/qw-su8-1020 aa6039f68/6a5ba57f8, bench lockstep vs SUVM7 projection PASS 11,787): command/record visible c_su 2 -> 6 = +4 (start pin +1, alignment +2, output pin +1); the VM8 programme answer +2 is the vm8b operand-read +2 term above (not added twice); BTAB bypasses SU (0); stride precompute 0; r4 per-lane stride registers 0 -> per_su_command stays 18 (still PRICED: slice2 does not bind su8 yet).

gaps: IMAGE CAPACITY: the full layer needs 13942 PW words (calendar 854 + tables 12608 = (PROG 72 + BTAB 188 + CROM 528) x 16) > CMD_CEIL 976: tt_ctlm cannot hold one layer's slice tables + calendar; and CROM post-scales / norm gains differ per layer (36 x) -> a per-layer table stream (ROM-resident slice tables or a table DMA) is needed

COLUMN-HEAD x CONSUMER: the qkv / gu / down / o matvecs read x from the slice x stream; the hr / xpf control that makes the column heads tap those words on the compiled edges is not lowered (QLB-C4b/3a left)
TILE DELIVERY: tile_first 40 (ME issue -> first far cluster word) and the AR stagger (slice s gets block b at M0 + 8 b + j - 26 - 2 s) are a contract no tool compiles into the ME / xhead calendar
PER-TOKEN RoPE ROW: cos / sin of the position must reach CROM ROPE every token; TLOAD plays static image blocks only (no producer of the per-token row on the die)
AR TAG CONTRACT (dv_lower_mat RTL gap): io_collective needs tag == cmd tag on every word and last only on the message last word; slice2 sends tag = row address, last per STN op (fault_code[2])
